properties.chose:
(a), the mirror rule, as its own gap source `understated_status` beside status_contradiction, at the lower severity (b) asked for — and not (c).

MEASURED FIRST, as the sizing caveat required, over nine design exports on 2026-09-30. Per CAPABILITY (still `planned`, with a realized Artifact realizing it or a passing check verifying it): 5 of 342 on reflow2's own design — cap:governance-proposal among them — 4 of 40 on a field design, 0 on the other seven, and every hit genuine. Per COMPONENT (still `planned`, hosting a realized/verified capability): 79 of 109 on reflow2, 11 of 21 on flo2, 6 of 8 on a third — exactly the designs that never move Component.status off its default (2, 0 and 0 moved) — and 0 on the three designs that keep the field. So the flood the caveat feared is real, it is the default nobody moved, and it lives in the COMPONENTS, not the capabilities.

WHAT WAS CHOSEN: capabilities and releases one finding each, like the overstatement mirror; the components ONE finding for the design, keyed on the SET, naming the practice and every component (the settled_decision_named_open shape) — an acknowledged set stays acknowledged, a component newly built behind `planned` asks again. Evidence is DIRECT only: an Artifact whose own status is planned or unset is not a build (fact:a-planned-artifact-that-realizes-a-capability-is-counted-as-built-2026-09-28), and a file or check on the component a capability is allocated to is not read for the capability (it would add 43 on reflow2). `in_progress` is never flagged. A release counts a DEPLOYED_TO not itself marked planned — the half tests/detect.rs assigned here and nobody wrote. Severity 0.40, beside decision_overtaken_by_promotion (the same lag one type over), below status_contradiction's 0.70.

WHY THE OTHERS LOST. (c) do nothing: understatement is what makes a design under-report its own completion and it accumulates silently — flo2's production gateway read `planned`. The same 0.70 as the mirror: an understated status is a record fallen behind evidence that exists, not a claim with nothing behind it, and misleads toward redoing work rather than into false confidence. Per-component findings: every one is true, but 79 of them on one design is the BL-73 flood read as noise and acknowledged unread. A stable aggregate id: one acknowledgement would then silence every later lag, the unreviewed_ideas cost. Reading component-level evidence for a capability: too loose, the looseness the unverified_capability exemption already rejected.

On Anthony's word, 2026-09-30: "Yes, fixes for 1-3 should go ahead" (fix 1 of the three is this rule).
properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL — found 2026-08-11 while answering Anthony's question about work built without a requirement. Nothing here is intent.

THE ASYMMETRY, read from the code rather than assumed. `detect_status_contradictions` (detect.rs:2146) fires in exactly two places, and both are OVERSTATEMENTS:
  · a Capability at `verified` with no passing check          → 0.70
  · a Requirement at `met` with nothing satisfying it         → 0.70
Nothing anywhere looks at the opposite direction.

THE INSTANCE THAT SURFACED IT: `cap:governance-proposal` sits at `planned` while `art:governance-proposal-skill` REALIZES it, it is allocated to `cmp:skills`, and that component's check passes. The skill is being SERVED to sessions right now. The status claims less than the structure shows, and no detector has an opinion.

⭐ THIS IS A NAMED-AND-UNBUILT CASE, NOT AN OVERSIGHT I INVENTED. The test at detect.rs:1401-1407 records the same limit from the Release side and assigns it: "a status that claims less than the structure shows is `status_contradiction`'s territory, not this one's." It was allocated to that detector and never written there.

IDEAS, unranked:
(a) Add the mirror rule to status_contradiction: a Capability at `planned`/`unrealized` with an incoming REALIZES, or with a passing check, is understating.
(b) Lower severity than 0.70. Overstating is a claim with nothing behind it; understating is a record that has fallen behind reality — arguably drift, not a contradiction, and drift already has its own machinery.
(c) Do nothing, on the grounds that understating harms nobody.

COUNTER-ARGUMENT TO (c), which is why this is worth asking at all: understating is what makes `graph_report`'s delivery count too LOW, and a design that under-reports its own completion is the one nobody trusts the numbers on. It is also the direction that silently accumulates, because nothing complains.

⚠️ SIZING CAVEAT before anyone treats (a) as small: `Release.status` and `Capability.status` both DEFAULT to `planned` (detect.rs:1401-1403 states this for Release). So "planned + realized" would fire on every capability whose status nobody ever set, which on a young design may be most of them. Whether that is signal or a flood is unmeasured, and measuring it is the first step, not the fix.
properties.name: An understated status IS reported — `understated_status`, from direct evidence, at 0.40, with the components as one finding keyed on the set
properties.rationale: status_contradiction is one-directional and its own test file assigns the other direction to it. The instance that exposed it is shipped, served code recorded as `planned`. The open part is whether the mirror rule floods, because `planned` is a schema default nobody chose.
